profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer / Engineering Manager @ SIMBA Chain | Software Development
profile.geoLocationName: Land O' Lakes, Florida, United States
profile.summary: Detail-oriented and solution-driven software developer, engineer, and researcher with over 14 years of commended performance in modular, functional, and object-oriented programming. Well-versed in all phases of the software development lifecycle. Solid mathematical knowledge with a strong working experience developing comprehensive algorithms and data-processing logic. Proven success at engineering customized solutions and improving business processes, operations and profitability for organizations of all sizes: from start-ups to large and well-established companies to universities.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Project Lead
positions.description:
- Represent Workstate as team leader and manager
- Lead small team of developers and established rapport with firm’s best client (Chemical Abstract Services)
- Maintain project/client-level documentation with onboarding and off-boarding instructions
- Enforce best practices for both server and client sides

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Enforced best practices for both server and client sides
- Developed RESTful endpoints
- Led front-end efforts for new projects/modules within FSR’s enterprise accounting application CamAcct
- Introduced Angular 2+ and integrated it with CamAcct’s preexistent ASP.NET Web Forms application
- Implemented RESTful services for generating and printing checks to emit payments for FSR’s vendors along with a UI to preview and directly print these checks
- Integration of CamAcct with third-party applications such as KlickPay, PositivePay, Lockbox, and AvidXChange
- Rewrote the front-end of CamAcct’s 1098/1099 IRS module
- Helped launch FSR’s Community Website (CWS) by implementing parts of both front- and backend of CWS Admin, a customized content management system
- Front-end responsible for FSR’s CamAcct Collections module (app/project creation and implementation) 
- Front-end additions to and modernization of FSR’s CamAcct, Lockbox, and BAI platforms, including searches, widgets and other functionality to help perform automatic bank reconciliations
- Responsible for keeping CamAcct working on Internet Explorer 9 using graceful degradation 
- Processed different files with accounting and financial information that are both sent and received by the CamAcct accounting system from different markets’ associates to FSR
- Actively contributed to Camacct’s UI/UX design
- Benchmarked and stressed solutions
- Wrote SQL Server stored procedures and scripts for Camacct
- Troubleshooted application issues

positions.title: Research Software Developer
positions.description:
- Co-inventor of ALADDIN (Any Ledger, Any Distributed Data, using Intelligent Networks), a research framework for designing, compiling and visualizing blockchain assets and transactions, as well as their relationships (Ember.js 3+, Node.js, Express.js, Solidity, SolC, web3, Dagre, D3.js, Swagger/Express OpenAPI)
- Co-inventor of SimbaChain (https://simbachain.com) (Ember.js, Node.js, Express.js, Solidity, SolC, web3, Dagre, D3, Swagger/Express OpenAPI)
- Developed web application for the CRAFT Vault, a CUI-compliant project funded by DARPA for application-specific integrated circuit and microchips design (Angular 6, Node.js, Express.js, Swagger/Express OpenAPI, Solidity, SolC, YAML, web3, Dagre, D3). A paper was published at the 11th International Workshop on Science Gateways (IWSG 2019), June 13, 2019.
- Contributed to the frontend implementation of NSF-funded project Whole Tale (http://wholetale.org/), particularly in its re-designed dashboard and the addition of new features (Ember.js 3+, Semantic UI)

- Involved with database and web development (C#, ASP.NET, AngularJS, SQL Server 2012)

positions.title: Software Engineering / Team Lead
positions.description:
- Lead small team of developers in building applications for multiple clients (ETECSA, Cubacel, DIE) for automating manual processes
- Served as a member of the CENTINEL project team, developing a system to ensure security with new industry standards for passport checking and facial recognition
- Developed and enhanced programs. Contributed to solutions that streamlined processes, increased accuracy, and lowered costs (C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC and SQL Server, some Java and QCodo PHP)
- Wrote specification requirements and defined use cases (Rational Rose)

projects.title: Pontem by Fidus Global
projects.description: Pontem is the first open architecture Warehouse Control System (WCS) that merges all your systems into one comprehensive open architecture platform. Pontem merges key Warehouse Management System (WMS), Warehouse Execution System (WES), and Warehouse Control System (WCS) functionalities into one comprehensive platform. Pontem does not replace an existing WMS. Rather, it communicates with ANY existing WMS to seamlessly integrate and control hardware i.e., sorters, conveyance, and robotics.

projects.title: WHOLETALE
projects.description:
Whole Tale is an NSF-funded Data Infrastructure Building Block (DIBBS) initiative to build a scalable, open source, web-based, multi-user platform for reproducible research enabling the creation, publication, and execution of tales - executable research objects that capture data, code, and the complete software environment used to produce research findings.

A beta version of the system is available at https://dashboard.wholetale.org.

The Whole Tale platform has been designed based on community input primarily through working groups and collaborations with researchers.
The Whole Tale project is involved in several initiatives to train researchers for reproducibility as well as use of Whole Tale in the classroom.

publications.title: A Secure Gateway for Enabling Application Specific Integrated Circuit Design Collaborations
Science, containerized: Integrating provenance and compute environments with the Whole Tale
publications.publisher: American Geophysical Union, Fall Meeting 2018, abstract #IN53A-02 · Dec 14, 2018

patents.title: Warehouse Control System
patents.description: The warehouse control system (WCS) coordinates communication between communicating devices and systems. The WCS stores mappings of different message types that are transmitted between different components of a warehouse. The WCS accepts inbound messages from the components, parses the inbound messages, and handles the data accordingly. The WCS also transmits outbound messages to components of the warehouse. The WCS forms the outbound message according to protocols defined in the WCS. The WCS maps positions of each message to predefined data fields to define the message type. The mapping of the fields to positions of each message type defines thefields of the message for future message handling.
